hero_question.reason: The hero answers exactly what Jana asks in the persona — why so little is left at the end of the month — by showing income against spending and what is left for each of the last six months.

about_customer.reason: Every tile is drawn from her real life: her month-end leftover, her own savings account as the emergency fund she asks about, her provisional Bern tax bill, her actual upcoming payments (rent, tax, gym, KPT premium), and her monthly repayment to her mother Andrea Widmer.

titles.reason: Titles are short and human, use her own framing ("What is left at month end" echoes her words about the end of the month), and each matches what its tile shows.

not_empty_or_repeated.reason: No tile is empty or pointless, and the tax bill standing beside the bills list is the allowed single-bill-with-detail pattern, here showing its provisional flag, while no other pair repeats the same thing in different words.

coherent.reason: Under the label "Every month" the board tells one story a customer would follow: how little is left each month, what she is building in the emergency fund, and which bills and obligations fall due around it.
